title: wtcraft Policy Envelope v1
description: A reviewed authorization record. The authoritative source is defined by docs/adr/009-policy-authority.md, not by this file's location in an implementation branch.

policy_id.description: Immutable policy record identifier. Do not reuse it for a replacement authorization.

task_id.description: Human-facing task identifier. It is not an approval identity.

repository.description: Canonical Git-hosting owner/name identity used by CI.

head_ref.description: Exact implementation branch ref authorized by this envelope. Any git-legal branch name is accepted, including non-ASCII names; the verifier applies the full git-check-ref-format rules.

base_sha.description: Exact 40-character Git commit SHA that the authorized branch must merge-base against.

allowed_paths.description: Repository-relative path patterns. Pattern semantics are defined by the verifier, not JSON Schema. `*` is the only supported wildcard and it matches `/`; `?` and `[]` are rejected so a pattern cannot mean something narrower in CI than it does in local `wtcraft check`.

off_limits.description: Repository-relative deny patterns evaluated before allowed_paths. Same wildcard restrictions as allowed_paths.

verification.description: Reviewed commands executed by the future protected verifier.

valid_until.description: Optional expiration time. The evaluator validates the RFC 3339 format so a malformed value fails closed; enforcing the deadline needs a trusted clock and is done by the CI adapter.
